testsuite.name: UC29 Track Previous Contacts
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: - A Virologist has authenticated themselves within iTrust2. UC2

step.actions: hcp: A Virologist, a type of HCP, uploads a list of contact data . At any point, the Virologist is still able to re-upload a contact list . Once a list of contact lists has been successfully uploaded, the Virologist may search for n-depth contacts of a source patient and view a list of these contacts along with the contacts' symptom severity level at an indicated time .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC2 - Exception Flow 1: No records or data available
testcase.summary: Exception Flow 1: No records or data available
testcase.preconditions: - A Virologist has authenticated themselves within iTrust2. UC2

step.actions: hcp: A Virologist, a type of HCP, uploads a list of contact data . At any point, the Virologist is still able to re-upload a contact list . Once a list of contact lists has been successfully uploaded, the Virologist may search for n-depth contacts of a source patient and view a list of these contacts along with the contacts' symptom severity level at an indicated time .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM prompts that If the Virologist attempts to search passenger contacts when passenger data has not been uploaded into the iTrust2 system, an error message appears saying, 'No passenger data is found.' The Virologist is advised to upload passenger data before attempting to track passenger contacts.

step.expectedresults: SYSTEM prompts that If the Virologist upload failed or the file was invalid, an error message is displayed saying, 'Invalid File'. The Virologist may re-attempt the upload. The existing data (if any) is not replaced.
